name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range.

name: Light
components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)
description: You touch an object and it emits bright light in a 20-foot radius.

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral hand appears that can manipulate objects remotely.

name: Prestidigitation
description: You perform a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A icy beam freezes a creature, slowing its movement.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature, dealing radiant damage.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Lightning springs from your hand, shocking the target.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You manipulate miracle at a distance, creating minor wonders.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: You unleash a string of insults at a creature.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature.

name: Magic Missile
description: Three darts of glowing force automatically hit targets.

name: Shield
description: An invisible barrier protects you, adding +5 to AC.

name: Mage Armor
components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
description: You touch a willing creature, giving them AC 13 + Dex modifier.

name: Burning Hands
description: As you hold your hands together, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth.

name: Charm Person
description: You attempt to charm a humanoid.

name: Comprehend Languages
components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot and salts)
description: You understand all spoken and written languages.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points.

name: Detect Magic
description: You sense the presence of magic within 30 feet.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
description: You can sense poison, poisonous creatures, or disease.

name: Disguise Self
description: You change your appearance to look different.

name: Faithful Hound
description: You create a phantom watchdog that alerts you to intruders.

name: False Life
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
description: You gain temporary hit points.

name: Feather Fall
components: V, M (a small feather or piece of down)
description: Nearby falling creatures descend slowly.

name: Floating Disk
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury)
description: You create a horizontal plane that can hold objects.

name: Fog Cloud
description: You create a 20-foot radius sphere of fog.

name: Grease
components: V, S, M (a bit of pork rind or butter)
description: Grease covers a 10-foot square, causing slipping.

name: Guidance
description: You touch a willing creature, granting guidance on next check.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature within range regains hit points.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature is imbued with bravery.

name: Hideous Laughter
components: V, S, M (a tiny pie and a feather)
description: A creature falls intofits of uncontrollable laughter.

name: Identify
components: V, S, M (pearl worth 100 gp and owl feather)
description: You identify magical properties of an object.

name: Longstrider
components: V, S, M (a piece of fur from a hound)
description: You increase a creature's speed by 10 feet.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
components: V, S, M (holy water or powdered iron)
description: You protect a creature from certain creatures.

name: Sanctuary
components: V, S, M (a white reed with a knot)
description: Warded creatures can't be seen and attack is disadvantage.

name: Sleep
components: V, S, M (a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket)
description: Creatures fall into a magical slumber.

name: Speak with Animals
description: You can comprehend and communicate with beasts.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you.

name: Unseen Servant
components: V, S, M (a piece of string and wood)
description: You create an invisible servant to perform simple tasks.

name: Witch Bolt
components: V, S, M (a twig from a tree struck by lightning)
description: You create a crackling bolt of energy that deals damage each turn.

name: Scorching Ray
description: You create three rays of fire.

name: Shatter
components: V, S, M (a chip of mica)
description: A loud ringing sound deals thunder damage.

name: Mirror Image
description: Three illusory duplicates appear to confuse attacks.

name: Misty Step
description: You teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Blur
description: Your outline becomes blurred, causing disadvantage on attacks.

name: Darkness
components: V, M (bat fur and a drop of pitch or coal)
description: Magical darkness spreads from a point.

name: Enhance Ability
components: V, S, M (fur or feather from a beast)
description: You enhance one ability score of a creature.

name: Flame Blade
components: V, S, M (a leaf of sumac)
description: You create a blade of fire that deals damage.

name: Flaming Sphere
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur)
description: A sphere of fire rolls around, dealing damage.

name: Heat Metal
components: V, S, M (a piece of iron and a flame)
description: You cause a metal object to glow with heat.

name: Hold Person
components: V, S, M (a small, straight piece of iron)
description: A humanoid you can see must make a Wisdom save or be paralyzed.

name: Invisibility
components: V, S, M (a lash of gum made from barley)
description: A creature you touch becomes invisible.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: You end one disease or condition from a creature.

name: Locate Object
description: You sense the direction of an object.

name: Melf's Acid Arrow
components: V, S, M (powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach)
description: Acid arrows travel to strike targets.

name: Moonbeam
components: V, S, M (several seeds of a moonseed plant)
description: A beam of pale light beams down.

name: Pass Without Trace
components: V, S, M (ashes from a burned leaf)
description: You leave no trace of your passage.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: Up to six creatures regain hit points.

name: Protection from Poison
description: You protect a creature from poison and disease.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: A beam causes a creature to become weaken.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: You create a floating weapon that attacks.

name: Web
components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)
description: You fill a 20-foot cube with sticky webs.

name: Acid Arrow
description: Arrows of acid splash on creatures.

name: Cloud of Daggers
description: A 5-foot cube is filled with floating daggers.

name: Conjure Animal
description: You summon a fey, celestial, or elemental to serve you.

name: Counterspell
description: You attempt to interrupt a creature casting a spell.

name: Dispel Magic
description: You end one or more spells on a creature or object.

name: Fireball
components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
description: A bright streak flashes to a point, exploding in fire.

name: Fly
description: A creature you touch gains a flying speed.

name: Gaseous Form
components: V, S, M (a bit of gauze and smoke)
description: A willing creature turns into gaseous form.

name: Haste
components: V, S, M (a shaving of licorice root)
description: A creature's speed doubles and gains extra actions.

name: Lightning Bolt
components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a glass rod)
description: A stroke of lightning deals lightning damage.

name: Major Image
components: V, S, M (a piece of wool)
description: You create an image that can move and speak.

name: Protect from Energy
description: A creature has resistance to one damage type.

name: Remove Curse
description: You remove all curses from an object or creature.

name: Revivify
description: You touch a creature dead for no more than a minute.

name: Sending
components: V, S, M (a piece of copper wire)
description: You send a short message to a creature.

name: Speak with Dead
description: You give speech to a corpse's corpse.

name: Tongues
components: V, M (a small clay model of a tongue)
description: A creature can understand all languages.

name: Water Breathing
components: V, S, M (a short reed or piece of straw)
description: Up to ten creatures can breathe underwater.

name: Wind Wall
components: V, S, M (a tiny fan and a feather)
description: A wall of strong wind blasts creatures.

name: Banishment
components: V, S, M (an item distasteful to the target)
description: You attempt to send a creature to another plane.

name: Chain Lightning
components: V, S, M (a bit of fur, a piece of amber, glass, or a crystal rod)
description: Lightning arcs to strike multiple targets.

name: Cone of Cold
components: V, S, M (a small crystal or glass cone)
description: A blast of cold air deals cold damage.

name: Conjure Elemental
description: You summon an elemental to serve you.

name: Greater Restoration
components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 100 gp)
description: You fully restore a creature's abilities.

name: Hold Monster
components: V, S, M (a small, straight piece of iron)
description: A creature you can see must make a Wisdom save or be paralyzed.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: Healing energy radiates to up to six creatures.

name: Raise Dead
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 500 gp)
description: You return a dead creature to life.

name: Scatter
description: You and up to five creatures teleport to other locations.

name: Telekinesis
description: You gain the ability to move objects with your mind.

name: Teleport
description: You teleport to a known location.

name: Resurrection
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 1,000 gp)
description: You return a dead creature to life.

name: Prismatic Spray
description: Colorful rays deal various effects.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
components: V, S, M (a miniature platinum sword)
description: You create a sword that attacks.

name: Finger of Death
description: You deal negative energy that can kill.

name: Plane Shift
components: V, S, M (a forked metal rod)
description: You shift to another plane of existence.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
description: A delayed ball of fire explodes later.

name: Etherealness
description: You step onto the Ethereal Plane.

name: Incendiary Cloud
description: A burning cloud deals fire damage.

name: Sunburst
description: Brilliant sunlight deals radiant damage.

name: Clone
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp)
description: You create a duplicate of a creature.

name: Mind Blank
description: A creature is immune to psychic damage and charm.

name: Power Word Stun
description: A word that can stun creatures.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Falling meteors deal fire and bludgeoning damage.

name: Power Word Kill
description: A word that kills creatures.

name: True Polymorph
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury)
description: You transform a creature into another form.

name: Wish
description: You replicate any spell of 8th level or lower.

name: Astral Projection
components: V, S, M (for each creature, a jade gemstone worth 1,000 gp)
description: You project to the Astral Plane.

name: Gate
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 5,000 gp)
description: You create a portal to another plane.

name: Invulnerability
components: V, S, M (a relic worth at least 5,000 gp)
description: You become immune to all damage.

name: Shapechange
components: V, S, M (a jade circlet worth 1,500 gp)
description: You assume the form of a different creature.

name: Time Stop
description: You take extra time to act.

name: True Resurrection
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 25,000 gp)
description: You resurrect a creature that has been dead for years.
